1.explanation:
• In the first snippet (SizeDemo), we render three Buttons side by side at different size props: default, large, and xl. This demonstrates whether the new sizes are picked up by the CSS.
• In the second snippet (ModalWithXlButtons), we open a ComposedModal and explicitly pass size="large" and size="xl" to the Buttons in the ModalFooter. According to the design spec, these should render at 64px and 80px tall, respectively. If they do not, the Button component’s styles for the new ‘large’ and ‘xl’ variants still need to be added to Button.scss and wired up in the component’s size map.
1.bug_scenario: In the existing Button component, we want to add two new size variants — “large” (height 64px / 8rem) and “xl” (height 80px / 10rem) — but they are not yet supported. In our modal footer we expect the “Previous” and “Next” buttons to render at 80px tall (size “xl”) alongside the modal, or at 64px tall (size “large”) in other contexts. Right now, passing size=“large” or size=“xl” has no effect: the buttons still render at the default height (40px).
